timezone.heading: Timezone
timezone.detail: Changing it re-reads existing departures at their new local times; it does not move them.
timezone.label: Timezone

contact.heading: Public contact details
contact.description: The front-desk email and phone printed on your course pages.
contact.detail: A diver who can't find a date gets a ready-written email to send you. Use an address the whole team reads. Empty the box to take the form down.

address.heading: Shop address
address.detail: Your shop's business address, not a staff member's. Published so search engines can place you as a real venue. Search for your shop by name or address, then pick it — that saves it.
address.noMatches: No matches. Try your shop's name, or a nearby street address.
address.lookupFailed: Address lookup isn't available right now. Try again in a moment.
address.lookupResting: That's a lot of lookups for one hour — searching pauses for a bit. Try again later.
address.notConfigured: Address lookup isn't set up on this DiveDay instance, so the address below can't be changed here.

reviewLink.heading: Review link
reviewLink.description: Your Google Business, TripAdvisor, or Facebook review page.
reviewLink.detail: When set, a diver's post-trip recap invites them to leave a review — empty the box to stop asking.
reviewLink.label: Review link

searchListing.heading: Search listing
searchListing.detail: Untick this and anything already indexed can take a few weeks to disappear — and a page someone has linked to stays reachable by that link.
searchListing.label: List my public pages in search engines

packing.heading: Trip packing checklist
packing.description: One item per line. Divers see this same concise list on every trip.
packing.label: Checklist items

dockCall.heading: Dock-day rhythm
dockCall.description: Every number here is in minutes.
dockCall.detail: These six numbers are the timeline your divers read as “Your dock-day rhythm” on their booking page, and the arrival call carries into confirmations and every pre-trip reminder. Set a beat to 0 and it drops out of the day entirely — that's how you say you brief on the boat, kit up on board, or dive from the beach. Beats before departure can never land earlier than your arrival call.
dockCall.dockCallDescription: How early divers are asked to be at the dock.
dockCall.gearSetupDescription: 0 if divers kit up on board.
dockCall.briefingDescription: 0 if you brief on the boat instead.
dockCall.boatRideLabel: Ride out to the first site
dockCall.bottomTimeLabel: Time in the water per dive
dockCall.siteOverrides: {count, plural, one {# dive site sets its own time in the water, so this rhythm doesn't describe a dive there:} other {# dive sites set their own time in the water, so this rhythm doesn't describe a dive at any of them:}}

sendWindow.heading: When we message divers
sendWindow.description: Reminders and recaps wait for these hours in your timezone. A cancellation always goes out straight away.

units.heading: Units
units.depthDetail: Depths are always stored in metres, so switching this changes only what you type in and read back — no recorded site depth moves.
units.temperatureDetail: Always stored in Celsius, so this changes only what you type and read.
units.currencyDetail: It converts nothing: a 130 trip stays 130, now meaning 130 of the new currency. Settled orders keep the currency they were charged in.
units.currencyMismatch: You charge in {shopCurrency}, but Stripe settles this account in {accountCurrency} and will refuse a payment it can't settle. Pick {accountCurrency} here, or connect an account that settles in {shopCurrency}.
units.currencyRepricingWarning: Changing this does not convert your prices. A $95 trip becomes 95 of the new currency, and orders already placed keep the currency they were charged in.

paymentsGate.notice: The rental catalog, rental prices, and Stripe connection are limited to owners and managers. The settings above are open to all staff.

rentals.heading: What we rent
rentals.detail: Untick anything you don't offer — it drops off the kit form and the prep list.
rentals.value: {count, plural, one {# item offered} other {# items offered}}

rentalPricing.heading: Rental prices
rentalPricing.description: What a diver is quoted for their rental fit.
rentalPricing.detail: Price the full set (usually cheaper) and each piece separately — five items quotes the set, fewer pays per piece. Leave a box blank to settle at the shop.
rentalPricing.fullSetHint: (BCD, reg, wetsuit, mask & fins, weights, dive computer)

stripe.notConnectedDetail: DiveDay never holds your money — payments for orders go straight into your own Stripe balance.
stripe.notConfiguredWarning: Online payments aren’t switched on for DiveDay yet — email {email} and we’ll get it set up.

embed.heading: Website embed
embed.description: Copy-paste snippets that put your live booking calendar on your own website.

calendar.heading: Calendar subscriptions
calendar.description: Put your departures on the calendar app you already use — read-only, so DiveDay never touches it.

trial.heading: Your trial
trial.activeDescription: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left, through {endDate}.
trial.expiredDescription: Your trial ended {endDate}. Everything you've set up keeps working.
trial.upgradeBody: Ready to move to a paid plan?
trial.value: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

support.description: A bad morning at the counter, a feature you're missing, a bug — write in any time.

whatsapp.heading: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Send trip reminders and recaps from your shop's own WhatsApp number instead of a platform SMS number.

backup.heading: Backups
backup.description: A weekly copy of everything your shop holds, delivered to storage you own.

team.heading: Team
team.description: Who works here, what each person is allowed to reach, and where your invitations stand.

diveSites.heading: Dive sites
diveSites.description: The site library the board picks from — depths, conditions, and what divers see there.

waivers.heading: Waiver template
waivers.description: The release every diver signs, and the log of who has signed it.

promos.heading: Promo codes
promos.description: Shop-wide discount codes a diver types at checkout, each with its own dates and limits.

mediaDeletions.heading: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} removed but not yet deleted from storage
mediaDeletions.detail: Retry the delete, or leave it for tonight's automatic retry.

processorErasures.heading: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} from an erased diver still at Stripe
processorErasures.detail: Erasing a diver also deletes their Stripe customer. These didn't finish. A customer record retries on its own tonight. An invoice can't: Stripe copies the name and email onto every invoice, and only a data-deletion request to Stripe clears that. File one, then mark it done.

dataImport.description: Bring contacts in from a CSV — matched to existing divers, never duplicated.

dataExport.description: Take everything your shop holds back out as a ZIP of CSVs.

emergency.value: {count, plural, one {# number} other {# numbers}} the crew can reach offline
emergency.intro: These ride on the boat manifest, including offline. DiveDay never fills them in — the nearest chamber and the right hotline depend on where you dive.

divePackages.value: {count, plural, =0 {No packages} one {# package} other {# packages}}
divePackages.description: Prepaid dives a diver buys once and spends across departures.
divePackages.validityDescription: Leave blank and it never expires.

notice.rolesInvalid: Check at least one role before saving.

notice.inviteEmailTaken: That email is already registered to a different shop.

invite.heading: Invite someone
invite.description: They'll get an email to set their own password. Inviting an existing diver by the same email adds staff access to their record instead of creating a second one.

current.heading: Current team
current.description: Enable, disable, and delete take effect immediately. Role changes below wait for Save changes.

export.title: Data export
export.description: Everything this shop keeps in DiveDay, as plain CSV — divers, certification records, trips, bookings, signed waivers, rental sizes, orders, wait lists, dive sites, and courses. Includes a ready-to-import contacts file.

downloadButton.acknowledged: On its way — check your downloads

bundle.heading: What's in the bundle
bundle.fileCount: {count, plural, one {# file, with a row count for each} other {# files, with a row count for each}}
bundle.description: One ZIP with a README and a CSV per record type. Every date carries its timezone, money is in cents, and deleted records come along too.

notIncluded.label: Not included, on purpose:
notIncluded.text: offline manifest copies, notification retry queues, Stripe account linkage, the close-out and buddy-team trails, weather-cancellation state, DiveDay's own reconciliation ledgers, and unstored pasted image URLs. Staff notes, the activity trail, notification outcomes, checkout attempts, promo redemptions and course leads <mono>do</mono> export. Photos and safely stored imported receipts export as real files in <mono>photos/</mono>. Credentials, calendar links, and your WhatsApp account never export — see the README.

import.title: Import contacts
import.description: Bring divers, certification records, rental sizes, and prior waiver acceptance in from a CSV — your old system's or DiveDay's own export.
import.comingFrom: Coming from <eve>EVE</eve>, <diveshop360>DiveShop360</diveshop360>, or <spreadsheet>a spreadsheet</spreadsheet>? See the matching guide, then come back here to bring it in.

notice.notAuthorized: Importing writes divers' personal and medical records, so it's limited to owners and managers.

contact.detail: Imported as given. A row with an email matches an existing diver on re-import; without one, it's always a new record.

emergencyContact.detail: Name and phone carry over when present.

diveInsurance.detail: Carried across as free text, exactly as your file holds it. Never a gate — just detail the crew wants on hand.

rentalSizes.detail: BCD, wetsuit, boot, and fin sizes become a rental-fit profile.

certificationCard.detail: Imported verified and flagged imported — staff give it a one-tap confirm; unrecognized levels need manual entry.

specialtyCards.detail: Imported as verified specialty certifications, flagged imported; each one still needs a staff confirm before the dive that requires it.

nitrox.detail: Imported as verified nitrox certification, flagged imported — but a diver gets plain air until staff confirm it; boarding never waits.

signedWaivers.detail: A row marked already-accepted is trusted, medical clearance included, and marked imported — individual medical answers are never reconstructed, only the outcome.

waiverDocuments.detail: Fetched once from your file's URL and re-stored in DiveDay's own storage for audit. Images and PDFs up to 5 MB.

role.detail: Everyone imports as a diver. Staff roles and logins are never granted by import.

cardOnFile.detail: Stay with your payment processor. DiveDay never imports card numbers or CVCs.

pastVisits.detail: One row per booking becomes visit history — not a dive, and it never appears on your schedule or counts toward capacity.

paymentHistory.detail: Source payment, refund, and receipt rows come across as unverified history in Orders. A clearly parsed amount in your shop currency is called out in the revenue/refund aggregate; it never becomes a live Stripe order or booking payment.

serviceHistory.detail: Stays behind — the importer carries diver records, never another system's equipment log. Your fleet's service clocks start fresh on the gear register.

diverNotes.detail: Customer remarks and staff notes carry over directly into private notes on the diver's profile.

wizard.heading: Upload a contacts file
wizard.intro: A CSV from your old system, or DiveDay's own <mono>contacts.csv</mono>. Nothing is written until you confirm the preview.
wizard.ignoredMedicalColumns: Left behind on purpose: {columns}. These weren't recognized as a waiver column, so their contents never import. A recognized “waiver accepted” column is trusted instead; see below.
wizard.waiverRowsNoticeOne: {count} row claims a waiver already accepted at a prior shop. DiveDay trusts that, medical clearance included, and marks it “imported”.
wizard.waiverRowsNoticeOther: {count} rows claim a waiver already accepted at a prior shop. DiveDay trusts that, medical clearance included, and marks it “imported”.
wizard.visitRowsNoticeOne: {count} row records a past visit. See “What comes across” above for what that does and doesn't mean.
wizard.visitRowsNoticeOther: {count} rows record a past visit. See “What comes across” above for what that does and doesn't mean.
wizard.paymentHistoryRowsNoticeOne: {count} payment, refund, or receipt source row will be imported as unverified history. They never create Stripe orders or charges.
wizard.paymentHistoryRowsNoticeOther: {count} payment, refund, or receipt source rows will be imported as unverified history. They never create Stripe orders or charges.
wizard.previewSwipeHint: Swipe the table to see every column →
wizard.hiddenRowsNoticeOne: Showing the first {limit} row. All {total} are imported on confirm.
wizard.hiddenRowsNoticeOther: Showing the first {limit} rows. All {total} are imported on confirm.

result.cardsLineOne: {cards} imported, flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm on each diver.
result.cardsLineOther: {cards} imported, flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm on each diver.
result.rowsMergedNote: {count} row(s) added certifications to a diver an earlier row brought in.
result.cardsSkippedNote: {count} certification(s) already on those divers' records were left untouched.
result.cardsHeldByAnother: {count} certification number(s) in the file are already on a different diver in your shop, so those records were not added to anyone. Check the file for a repeated number, then review and add the certification records in DiveDay.
result.specialtyGateNote: A dive that requires one of those specialties waits on that confirm — tap it on the diver's record and the gate opens.
result.waiversLineOne: {count} waiver imported as accepted, marked “imported” on the diver's profile.
result.waiversLineOther: {count} waivers imported as accepted, marked “imported” on the diver's profile.
result.waiversSkippedExistingNote: {count} diver(s) already had a current waiver on file, left untouched.
result.waiversSkippedNoTemplateNoteOne: {count} skipped — set up a waiver template first.
result.waiversSkippedNoTemplateNoteOther: {count} skipped — set up a waiver template first.
result.waiverDocumentsFailedNote: {count} document link(s) didn't fetch and were left off the record.
result.visitsLineOne: {count} past visit added to divers' shop history.
result.visitsLineOther: {count} past visits added to divers' shop history.
result.visitsSkippedNote: {count} were already imported and were left as they are — re-running the same export doesn't double anyone's history.
result.paymentHistoryLineOne: {count} unverified payment / receipt source record added to Orders.
result.paymentHistoryLineOther: {count} unverified payment / receipt source records added to Orders.
result.paymentHistorySkippedNote: {count} payment-history rows were already present and were left as they are.
result.notesLineOne: {count} internal note imported to diver profiles.
result.notesLineOther: {count} internal notes imported to diver profiles.
result.receiptDocumentsFailedNote: {count} receipt document link(s) didn't fetch and were left off the source record.

issues.emailInvalid: Email "{email}" doesn't look valid — imported without an email.
issues.cardMarkedUnverified: Your file marks this certification "{status}" — imported for staff review rather than as verified, since your own records don't call it checked.
issues.specialtyNotGated: Specialty "{specialty}" isn't a specialty we gate on (deep, wreck, night, drysuit) — nothing imported for it.
issues.specialtyNoCardNumber: Specialty "{specialty}" has no certification number on the row — not imported. A certification without a number can't be verified.
issues.specialtyImportedVerifiedOne: Specialty certification imported as verified from your records, flagged imported. A dive that requires one waits until a staffer confirms they've seen it.
issues.specialtyImportedVerifiedOther: {count} specialty certifications imported as verified from your records, flagged imported. A dive that requires one waits until a staffer confirms they've seen it.
issues.specialtyImportedPendingOne: Specialty certification imported for staff review — see the note above.
issues.specialtyImportedPendingOther: {count} specialty certifications imported for staff review — see the note above.
issues.levelNamesSpecialty: Certification "{level}" names a specialty, not a level, and this row's specialty column was used instead — no level certification imported. Add that certification record in DiveDay if it's a separate one.
issues.levelIsTechnical: Certification "{level}" is a technical or overhead rating, not a recreational rung — not imported, and never read as a nearby level. Record it by hand if your shop gates on it.
issues.levelNotGated: Certification "{level}" isn't a level we gate on — certification not imported. Add the record in DiveDay if your shop needs to keep it.
issues.levelNoCardNumber: Certification level "{level}" has no usable certification number — certification not imported. Evidence without a number can't be verified.
issues.certImportedVerified: Certification imported as verified from your records — flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm for staff.
issues.certImportedPending: Certification imported for staff review — see the note above.
issues.nitroxImported: Nitrox certification imported as verified from your records — flagged imported. Fills give plain air until a staffer taps confirm.
issues.nitroxNoCardNumber: Nitrox marked on the source with no certification number — add and verify the nitrox certification in DiveDay.
issues.waiverDateInvalid: Waiver accepted date "{value}" isn't a real calendar date (expected YYYY-MM-DD) — imported dated to today instead.
issues.waiverImported: Waiver imported as accepted — trusted from the prior shop, medical clearance included, and marked “imported”.
issues.dobInvalid: Date of birth "{value}" isn't a plausible calendar date (expected YYYY-MM-DD, 1900 or later, not in the future) — imported without it.
issues.visitDateUnreadable: Visit date "{value}" isn't a date we can read — the diver imports without this visit.
issues.visitNoReference: Visit imported without a booking reference — a re-import matches on date, name, and amount, so two identical bookings on one day come in as one visit.
issues.visitNoDate: This row names a past booking but carries no date — the diver imports without this visit.
issues.paymentHistoryDateUnreadable: Payment history date "{value}" isn't a date we can read — that source record won't import.
issues.paymentHistoryNoDate: This payment or receipt source row has no usable date, so it won't import.
issues.mergedDuplicate: Same diver as row {row} ({email}) — this row's certifications, waiver, and past visit are added to them, contact details left as the earlier row has them.
issues.noEmailNewRecord: No email — imported as a new record; a re-import can't match it to update.

errors.notOwnerOrManager: Importing contacts is limited to the shop's owner or manager.
errors.csvRequired: Choose a CSV file to import.
errors.noImportableRows: No importable rows — every row was missing a name or duplicated.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large — the limit is {limitMb} MB.
errors.tooManyColumns: Too many columns ({count}) — the limit is {limit}.
errors.tooManyRows: Too many rows ({count}) — the limit is {limit} per import. Split the file and import it in batches.
errors.cellTooLongHeader: A cell in the header row is longer than {limit} characters — check for a pasted document instead of a spreadsheet.
errors.cellTooLongRow: A cell in row {row} is longer than {limit} characters — check for a pasted document instead of a spreadsheet.
errors.noNameColumn: No name column found. The file needs a full name, or first and last name, to import people.

embed.title: Website embed
embed.description: Paste one of these into your website so divers can browse and book without leaving it.
embed.notConfigured: Embed links need a configured public hosting address for this DiveDay instance — contact {email} to get it set up.

calendarEmbed.heading: Calendar embed
calendarEmbed.description: Your next four departures with a link through to the rest, sized so it never scrolls inside your page. Best for a dedicated "Book now" page on your site.
calendarEmbed.attributionNote: Includes a small "Powered by DiveDay" credit link under the calendar, on your own page — not inside the widget.

bookButton.heading: "Book a dive" button
bookButton.description: A plain link styled as a button — no iframe. Opens your schedule in a new tab, and the one to use if you take online payment, since a checkout page may refuse to load in another site's frame.

embed.footer: Both snippets point at <link>your public schedule</link>. Trip edits, new departures and price changes show up the moment a diver loads the embed.
